title: P1-F0 F0-C send/flush fanout derived calibration

phases.label: Dispatch a synthetic DOM pointerup/click and observe derived send/flush/fanout work
Keep the page foreground-active after the derived fanout action completes

sop: F0-C is derived fanout calibration only.
F0-C is not product trace replay.
F0-C uses structural fanout variables and deterministic derived work over accumulated session state.
F0-C requires one smoke first; no 3x run is allowed until separately approved.
Load the P1-F0 target and confirm visible audit state shows config_valid=true and capture_allowed=true.
Confirm scenario_mode=p1-f0-send-flush-fanout, calibration_level=derived, payload_shape=derived-json, content_richness=derived, and derived_work_enabled=true.
Confirm selector_passes_per_subscriber, queue_drain_steps_per_module, state_read_stride, derived_hash_rounds, and projection_update_count match the approved F0-C cell.
Confirm stable_keys=true, react_memo_enabled=true, deferred_rendering=false, token_coalescing=false, and synthetic_pressure_multiplier=1.
Press Enter only after the page is loaded and the Chrome window is foreground-active.
Do not interact with the page during capture; the target dispatches synthetic DOM pointerup/click events on the visible send button when it observes p0:capture:start.
Keep the Chrome window foreground-active for the full 12 second capture window.
